title: Claude Code Config
description: Configuration for ~/.claude — Claude Code personal environment

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference (for VS Code IntelliSense)

dbPath.description: Path to the SQLite LTM database

decayEnabled.description: Whether memory decay scoring is active (stale memories lose relevance over time)

autoRelate.description: Auto-detect and create relations between similar memories after each learn() call using LLM classification

injectTopN.description: Maximum number of LTM memories injected at session start

server.description: Graph UI and API server ports

apiPort.description: Port for the Bun API server (server.ts)

uiPort.description: Port for the Next.js graph UI (graph-app/)

sync.description: Optional cloud sync for the LTM database
